name: Application Health
description: Sent when an application changes status. This is a system notification email.
subject: Application health alert: '$name' is now in #if ($healthy) a Healthy #{else} an Unhealthy #{end} state
body:
Application Health Notification

An application in your environment has changed status. Review the details below.

Application
$name

Status
#if ($healthy) Healthy #{else} Unhealthy #{end}

#if ($since) This status has been reported since $since ago. #{end}

Please sign in to $PRODUCT_NAME for more information.

Thank you,
The $PRODUCT_NAME Team

You are receiving this email because your email address is configured to receive $PRODUCT_NAME notification emails.
